meta.note: Real Aug-7 pilot form (Priority 0). Questions + limits transcribed from sources/aug7-pilot-forms.md#form-2. Rich word/character limits — the primary resize test case. Run with --resize to exercise pipeline/resize.py.

questions.text: What is the name of your solution?
Provide a one-line summary or tagline for your solution.
What specific problem are you solving? What is the scale of the problem in the communities you are working in?
What is your solution and how does it work?
Who does your solution serve, and in what ways will the solution impact their lives?
What have you built and tested so far? Please share why you selected your stage of development.
What makes your solution innovative? How is it distinct from others using a similar approach?
Describe in simple terms how and why you expect your solution to have an impact on the problem (your theory of change).
How are you and your team well-positioned to deliver this solution?
Why are you applying to the Truist Foundation Inspire Awards?
How many people work on your solution team (full-time, part-time, contractors)?
How long have you been working on your solution?
What is your plan for becoming financially sustainable, and what evidence supports it?
What was your organizational budget for fiscal year 2025 and 2026?
How is your current budget allocated?
